title: Rota
description: A sibling rota for one senior. The on-duty contact gets most notifications; red flags still go to all.

mode.description: weekly: each contact gets 7 days; daily: rotates every day

start_date.description: First day of the rota (SGT). Days before this return no on-duty contact.

order.description: Contact ids in rotation order. An empty array means no rota (same as no rota at all).

swaps.description: One-off overrides: a swap for an exact date wins over the rotation for that date only.
